label: nyiso 9 priced-interchange
definition: U8 (root-cause of the nyiso-8 2023 upstate collapse): serves NYISO's net imports through the PRICED import/export node (--priced-interchange) instead of folding the measured -23.5 TWh net-interchange wedge into demand by load-share. The fold deflated Upstate's true load (51.2->43.0 TWh) every hour, manufacturing a ~1760 MW surplus that over-bound the (correct, measured) Central-East limit and floored Upstate to $6 (actual $25.3); the real interface NEVER binds in 2023 (ExternalLimitsFlows: mean 1329 vs 1741 MW limit, 0% bound). With the priced node Upstate keeps its full load and imports flow only when economic: 2023 Upstate $6->$32.6 (MAE 10.98->3.45), 2024 MAE 2.34->1.28. BUT the stock IMPORT_NODE_LINKS land imports in Capital_Hudson/Lower_Hudson (which physically have no net-import tie), so cheap power bypasses Central-East and the west->east spread COLLAPSES (Cap-Up +0.1 vs actual +7.9; 2025 MAE 3.18->7.37, downstate too low). (PROBE) Root cause localized to import-node ZONE PLACEMENT -> fixed in nyiso 10.
